record.context_brief: Birational categorical Torelli for Gushel-Mukai varieties
record.original_question: If X1 and X2 are Gushel-Mukai varieties of the same dimension and their Kuznetsov components are equivalent, must X1 and X2 be birational?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 6.18 ([90], Conjecture 1.7). If X1 and X2 are Gushel-Mukai varieties of the same dimension such that there is an equivalence Ku(X1 ) -> Ku(X2 ), then X1 and X2 are birational.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A Gushel–Mukai (GM) variety is a smooth complex projective variety X of dimension n with 2 ≤ n ≤ 6 obtained as a transverse intersection of the cone (in P^{10}) over the Grassmannian Gr(2,5) ⊂ P^9 (in its Plücker embedding) with a linear subspace and a quadric hypersurface, in such a way that X has Picard rank 1, index n−2, and degree 10. To any GM variety X one associates its Kuznetsov component Ku(X), the full triangulated subcategory of the bounded derived category D^b(X) defined as the right orthogonal to the admissible subcategory generated by an exceptional collection involving O_X, U_X^∨ (the dual of the tautological rank-2 subbundle pulled back from Gr(2,5)), together with their twists by O_X(1) when n is even.

Prove or disprove the following: for any two GM varieties X_1 and X_2 of the same dimension n, the existence of an exact C-linear equivalence of triangulated categories Ku(X_1) ≃ Ku(X_2) implies that X_1 and X_2 are birational.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture is in general open. Partial progress is known: in dimension three the conjecture has been established under a mild additional assumption (categorical Torelli–type results for GM threefolds), and related Kuznetsov–Perry duality results connect Kuznetsov components of GM varieties of different dimensions. No proof in full generality across all dimensions has been published.

status_evidence.title: Categorical Torelli theorems for Gushel–Mukai threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: A conjecture of Kuznetsov–Perry in dimension three has been proven under a mild assumption.
status_evidence.claim: The dimension-three case of the conjecture has been established under a mild assumption.

status_evidence.title: Categorical resolutions and birational geometry of nodal Gushel–Mukai varieties
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of the GM analogue of Kuznetsov's rationality conjecture and Kuznetsov-Perry birational categorical Torelli conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: The general conjecture remains an active research topic, with extensions to singular GM varieties still being developed.

status_evidence.title: Derived categories of Gushel–Mukai varieties
status_evidence.snippet: Foundational paper of Kuznetsov–Perry on the Kuznetsov component of GM varieties.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes the framework and original conjectures on Ku(X) for GM varieties.
